Build a flat, all-compounds feature table with CAMERA grouping context

build_compound_instance_table.Rd

Long table: one row per feature within a compound instance, across EVERY compound instance present in eval_full (not one queried compound at a time, unlike inspect_compound). Reuses the same per-feature anchor-co-grouping logic as inspect_compound's internal long_table, and adds:

CAMERA_isotopes, CAMERA_adduct

CAMERA's own native annotation columns, kept SEPARATE (not combined into one string) so downstream parsing of CAMERA's adduct hypotheses (e.g. neutral-mass cross-checks) is not obstructed by a merged column.

CAMERA_anno_correct

TRUE/FALSE: does CAMERA's own adduct call on THIS feature match the compound's true neutral mass (within anno_accuracy's ppm tolerance), established from that compound's own Tier1a/Tier1a_exp evidence. Applies across ALL tiers (a Tier1b/1c/1d/Tier2 feature's CAMERA adduct call is checked against the same compound-level mass), not only Tier1a/Tier1a_exp. NA when it cannot be evaluated: CAMERA assigned no adduct annotation at all, or the compound has no resolvable neutral mass.

CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_purity

Number of distinct reference compounds whose Tier1a anchor falls in this compound's anchor pcgroup. How many OTHER compounds is CAMERA merging this one with. Shown only on the row(s) co-grouped with the anchor.

CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_Refconfirmed_pct

This compound's own anchor-co-grouped feature count (X) / total anchor pcgroup feature count (Y) x 100. Shown only on the row(s) co-grouped with the anchor.

Usage

build_compound_instance_table(
  eval_full,
  anchors,
  purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT,
  anno_accuracy
)

Arguments

eval_full

data.frame. Output of build_eval_full.

anchors

data.frame. Output of build_anchors.

purity

list. Output of build_pcgroup_purity. The all_pcgroups element is used for purity / feature-count context.

CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT

data.frame. CAMERA-annotated feature table. Used ONLY as a fallback source for pcgroup/adduct/isotopes if eval_full is missing those native columns – normally eval_full's own pcgroup, CAMERA_adduct, and isotopes columns are used directly (the same columns build_anno_accuracy() reads), so this table and CAMERA_anno_correct can never silently disagree for the same row.

anno_accuracy

list. Output of build_anno_accuracy. Its feature_level element is joined in to populate CAMERA_anno_correct.

Value

A data.frame, one row per feature within a compound instance, with columns: compound_instance, MS1Match_lib_group, MS1Match_reference_tier, feature_name, MS1Match_anno, MS1Match_iso, CAMERA_group_status, CAMERA_isotopes, CAMERA_adduct, CAMERA_anno_correct, CAMERA_pcgroup, CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup, CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_purity, CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_Refconfirmed_pct.

See also

inspect_compound, build_pcgroup_purity, build_anno_accuracy
